instructions.visarga_echo: For Visarga (ः), release an audible echo of the preceding vowel (e.g. 'a-ha' after 'a', 'i-hi' after 'i').
instructions.aspiration_loss: Aspiration missing. Release a strong burst of breath from the vocal tract.
instructions.vowel_shortened: Long vowel was shortened. Maintain vowel duration for two morae (matras).
instructions.schwa_deleted: Do not delete the final inherent vowel. Classical Sanskrit pronounces every final vowel fully.
